mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, agent_key, session_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM t_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_session (user_id, agent_key, session_id, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{agentKey}, #{sessionId}, #{title})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM t_chat_session WHERE agent_key = #{agentKey} AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
